Every registration also pays a small ripple fee proportional to puzzle difficulty, so mass identity creation costs grow superlinearly. An attacker running ten thousand sybils must pay ten thousand bonds plus compute, making the attack economically irrational. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry...
